name: Coleman Large 8 Person 14' x 10' Weathertec Instant Set Up Outdoor Camping Tent
description: Get ready to see everything there is to see in the great outdoors with your friends or the entire family, because with the Coleman 8 Person 14 x 10 Foot Instant Set Up Camping Tent, you'll have so much more room for activities (like sleeping and telling ghost stories!) Don't mess around with pole assembly on your next family camping trip. Right out of the bag, this tent expands and sets up in just 60 seconds. This family tent also features 2 doors and 7 windows for more views of the outdoors as well as ventilation. With 140 square feet of floor space, there's plenty of room for 8 people or 2 queen air mattresses, plus you can split the tent in 2 with the included wall divider. You don't have to worry about the wind and rain either, because with Weathertec and welded 150D polyester construction, you'll stay nice and dry. With a handy setup guide and everything you need included, you'll be up and running with the Coleman 8 Person 14 x 10 Foot Instant Set Up Camping Tent in no time for your next outdoor adventure!
